text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, guess what? During my time off, I went fishing with Dia!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We caught bucketloads of fish, and everyone praised us for getting such a big haul!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Next time, I wanna try landing a really huge catch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Kitasan Black thoroughly enjoyed her day off and is fully revitalized!
